description_en: Retrieves the list of security capabilities associated with normalization rules
description_zh: 获取标准化规则安全能力列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-rule-capacities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-rule-id nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --normalization-rule-ids nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationRuleCapacities

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center resides. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
This parameter is required in practice. If you do not specify this parameter or pass an empty string, the API returns a 400 error (The specified Lang can not be empty.)
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
此参数实际为必填项，未传或传空字符串时API返回400错误（The specified Lang can not be empty.）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the view of another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The list of normalization rule IDs
parameters.name: normalization_rule_ids

MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

NormalizationRuleCapacities.description_en: The list of security capabilities associated with normalization rules
NormalizationRuleCapacities.description_zh: 标准化规则关联的安全能力列表

CapacityType.description_en:
The type of the security capability. Valid values:
detection_preset_rule: predefined analysis rule.
detection_custom_rule: custom analysis rule.
incident_investigation: security incident handling.
soar_playbooks: predefined playbook

安全能力类型。取值：
detection_preset_rule：预定义分析规则。
detection_custom_rule：自定义分析规则。
incident_investigation：安全事件处理。
soar_playbooks：预定义剧本
